# 310_R6FIX.39 — lifecycle mutations die in `onMutate` on the `["bff","app"]` prefix match

**Harness:** devin-cli / swe-2-high · **Layer:** engineered · **Spend:** $0

Nightly T6/T7 red since the R7b `/app` deploy wave: the delete POST never left the browser
(fixture rows untombstoned; zero `POST /p/:slug/delete` at web/api in 24h — every user's
row lifecycle actions dead). Live repro at `73902381` (flagged tenant, $0,
`reports/2026-11-17_T6-repro/`): row + `⋯` + enabled `[data-menu-action="delete"]` all
present; click and Enter issue no request — only the `["bff","app"]`-prefix invalidation
pair (`/bff/app` + `/bff/app/inbox`) plus the `toastFailed` toast. Root cause:
`patchTwinRows`'s `getQueriesData({queryKey:["bff","app"]})` prefix-matches the
`["bff","app","inbox"]`/`["bff","app","new"]` siblings whose payloads lack
`rows`/`deletedRows` — `data.rows.map` throws TypeError inside `onMutate`, aborting the
mutation before `mutationFn`/`bffFetch`. Fix: `homeTwinEntries()` filters the prefix
results to home-shaped payloads for both the patch loop and the rollback snapshot.
Regression test seeds the inbox sibling + clicks delete → asserts the POST (fails pre-fix).
project-home.dom.test 19/19 · typecheck/lint/copy-containment green. Stage B owed
post-deploy: T6/T7 green, real-user delete POSTs resume; F-16/BL-105 disposition then.
